rejected_claims.reason: Performance figures are partly contradicted by the fetched release-post evidence and the grading patterns are exact-string matches on those disputed numbers. The independently fetched summary of https://bun.com/blog/bun-v1.4 reports HTTP-server memory reductions of 13-48% (Fastify -48%, Express -46%), which conflicts with 'up to 35% lower memory usage', and reports Linux startup as '2x faster', which the required pattern '50% faster startup on Linux' would not match in any faithful answer. Only '5x lower idle CPU usage' is corroborated, leaving the claim as written unsupported and lexically ungradeable.
